arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back, ~57 min. Goal: even effort near sustainable shaft power (pod CP 147 W, est. sustainable ~150 W), spend pod reserve evenly, finish sprint from ~600 m left. Steps: (1) let start settle by min 3; (2) min 5-15 judge CP from heart-rate trend at steady effort (rising HR at steady power = above CP); consider a short test piece to check CP/efficiency if unclear; (3) watch for drag incidents (push_local falls at same pod power in both directions = weed/drag), pod drift (pod vs boat power ratio shifts), radio course changes; (4) final 600 m: finish cue.

PUZZLE: from ~630 s pod fell to 132 W while GPS rose 3.28->3.52 (wind arrived) and HR kept climbing 162->164 (+1.2/min) and paddler said 6/10 steady. Either pod drifting low (gain ~0.8) or paddler eased in tailwind. TEST: two-direction fit with post-wind south window 700-789 s + north leg window: share ~0.67 = pod fine; ~0.84 = pod reads low (set pod_gain). Pre-wind share 0.672, push 0.22 (current south). Set boat CP 99 W, reserve 9.2 kJ.

arguments.name: pod_gain
arguments.evidence: Pod fell 166->132 W over 627-731 s with no cue, while HR kept rising and GPS rose. Two-direction fit after the wind (south 700-789 s, north 880-968 s): share 0.79 vs 0.672 before; at share 0.672 GPS residuals +0.68 south / -0.38 north = +0.15 m/s in both directions = pod reads low. 0.672/0.79 = 0.85; building wind biases this up, so 0.83.

arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m; odd legs north INTO current+wind (push about -0.5 m/s), even legs south WITH it (+0.5); leg 8 (finish) is south. Pod reads LOW since ~700 s (pod_gain 0.83 set; corrected numbers shown). Pod CP 147 W (HR flat at 147, climbing slowly at 160-168). Pacing: true effort ~160 W on north legs (piece +8-10 %), ~135-138 W on south legs (piece -10 %), keep corrected pod reserve above ~15 % until leg 8; finish sprint from ~500 m left on leg 8. Each turn: cue the next leg. Re-check pod gain each leg pair with measure (two directions, share 0.672 pre-drift); HR is the cross-check of true effort.
